label: Diagram 2
caption: Diagram 2 Branch connection to stacks – crossflow prevention
description: The drawing, titled "Diagram 2 Branch connection to stacks – crossflow prevention", contains several line drawings of pipes with circular zones marked on a vertical stack. At top left, text reads: "A branch creates a no connection zone on a stack. No other branch may be fitted such that its centre line falls inside a zone but its centre line may be on the boundary of the zone." A small isometric shows two opposed branches on a stack, labelled "offset". A central stack diagram marks a zone "A" at top and "B" lower, with "lowest connection" and "wc" beside B; a curved pipe descends to "drain invert", dimensioned "450mm min *" vertically from the lowest connection to the drain invert, with "200mm" marked as the radius of the bend. The right diagram, captioned "Opposed branch connection in the horizontal plane should be avoided", shows two branches with "50mm parallel junction", "50mm min" and "200mm". A Key at bottom left defines A as opposed connections without swept entries not exceeding 65mm, which should be offset 110mm on a 100mm diameter stack or 250mm on a 150mm diameter stack; a note below the Key states that opposed connections larger than 65mm (without swept entries) should be offset at least 200mm irrespective of stack diameter, and that unopposed connections may be at any position. Bottom right defines B as an angled connection or 50mm diameter parallel junction where a branch discharge pipe would enter the WC no connection zone; an NB note states that a waste (branch discharge pipe) manifold may be a suitable alternative, and an asterisk note states that the dimension should be increased in buildings over 3 storeys.
